comments.body: issue (high): 🟠 **FAIL reasons from other gates vanish when findings exist** **(blocking)** With any finding present, a Gate 3/4/5 failure is no longer named above the accordion, so a FAIL run can headline `N non-blocking findings`. Reproduced on `fail.json` with the blocker unset. ```js // keep gate reasons; drop only what the table already shows const gateReasons = reasonPhrases.filter((r) => !isCodeReviewPhrase(r) || n === 0); const reasonsLine = gateReasons.length ? `**${verdict === "FAIL" ? "Blocking" : "Warnings"}:** ${gateReasons.join(" · ")}` : ""; ``` _Pseudo-code — verify before applying._ `pr-reviewer` · commit `2b60ca1`

issue (medium): 🟡 **`--findings` skips the page that render-png needs** **(non-blocking)** Phase 5 is what builds `page.html`, and `render-png.mjs` takes that page as input while step 4 edits its legend. Skipping phase 5 leaves nothing to render, so the image step falls back to no image. ```markdown Diagram only, for a `pr-reviewer` report: … Builds the page (phase 5) without publishing it, skips phases 3 and 6, and writes nothing to GitHub. ``` `pr-reviewer` · commit `2b60ca1`

suggestion (medium): 🟡 **Old layout still documented later in this file** **(non-blocking)** This section is updated, but lines 656-735 still describe the `**Checked:**` line, the reach accordion, a `Status` gate column, `COVERAGE_LINE`, and the old headline. The file now contradicts itself. `pr-reviewer` · commit `2b60ca1`

suggestion (medium): 🟡 **Keep per-export reach detail or accept counts only** **(non-blocking)** The Reach row now carries only totals, so without the optional image the report no longer names which exports or files were traced. This rule still calls that per-export note the auditable record. `pr-reviewer` · commit `2b60ca1`

suggestion (medium): 🟡 **No L1 coverage for decide, fix, or IMPACT_IMAGE** **(non-blocking)** These checks cover the new headline but not the `decide` rows, the `fix` cap, the blocking+decide reject, or the `IMPACT_IMAGE` url and placement guards. A regression in any of them ships green. `pr-reviewer` · commit `2b60ca1`

nitpick (low): The trailing `FINDINGS`/`QUALITY` cross-check sentence landed in a fourth cell of this row, which GitHub drops; it belongs at the end of the `FINDINGS` row above. **(non-blocking)**

<sup>`pr-reviewer` · commit `2b60ca1`</sup>
